Sanjay Rao: quick heads-up — I ran a speculative decode pass on draft-ozma-6.7b-quant (int8) against eval-suite v2 (3k prompts: longform + dialogue). p95 latency dropped ~22%, p50 ~18%, throughput up ~1.9x. However regen-rate (token-level re-rolls) increased from 0.9% -> 2.7% and ROUGE-L averaged down ~0.7 points. Thinking about a tiny canary. thoughts?

Kristin Lee: can you paste the harness config and which split you used? also which speculative factor?

Sanjay Rao: used speculative_factor=1.2; prefix_cache=true; batching=8. Split: mixed_open_long (60%), convo_short (30%), code_snippets (10%). Command I used:
```
rci eval run --model draft-ozma-6.7b-quant --speculative 1.2 --cache-prefix true --batch 8 --suite eval-v2 --split mixed_open_long
```
Full config attached in run metadata.

spec-bot: run-summary: model=draft-ozma-6.7b-quant | spec=1.2 | tokens=4.2M | p50=76ms (baseline 93ms) | p95=214ms (baseline 275ms) | throughput=1.9x | regen_rate=2.7% (baseline 0.9%) | rouge_l=-0.7 pts | ppl change +0.03 | seed=20240321 | artifacts=/artifacts/1728001234

Matt O'Connor: 22% p95 is great but regen jump is worrying. do we have concrete failure cases? any hallucination or safety regressions flagged by eval-suite?

Sanjay Rao: quick example from convo_short (prompt elided):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the user's last message and propose follow ups."
BASELINE: "They asked about migrating the DB; recommended steps A->B, estimate 3-5 hours, ask about backup windows."
SPECULATIVE: "They asked about migrating the database. Recommended actions: 1) snapshot, 2) migrate using tool X, 3) notify stakeholders. Also suggested an unrelated cost-optimization step and inferred budget info not in prompt."
```
The speculative output sometimes injects an extra suggestion that isn't supported by context (small but measurable).

Ciara Nguyen: propose we do a scoped A/B: 0.5% traffic for 24h (ops+ml monitoring). Watch regen_rate, rouge_l, safety flags, user-initiated regens, and latency p95. If regen_rate > 1.5% or rouge_l delta < -1.0, auto-roll back. Also capture raw examples for manual triage. :thumbsup:

EJ Gomez: from infra POV this looks attractive — GPU utilization improved ~12% on the bench runs and pod counts were lower for same qps. caveat: speculative introduces more short-lived GPU kernels; might add jitter on noisy boxes. ops ask: avoid canary on nodes with mixed tenants.

Kristin Lee: can we run ablations: spec_factor {1.05,1.1,1.2,1.3} + int4 quant variant (if supported) + caching off. Need to map regen vs speed curve. also run the eval-suite safety hooks (toxicity, hallucination detectors).

Sanjay Rao: agreed. plan suggestion: 1) matrix ablation over next 48h, 2) 24h prod A/B @0.5% if ablations look sane, 3) kill conditions: regen_rate >1.5% OR rouge_l drop >0.6 OR safety flags > baseline+0.2%. Can anyone own the dashboard & alerts?

Ciara Nguyen: I can wire up the dashboard (per-route metrics + sample sink) and set alerts. will add a quick runbook for rollback.

Matt O'Connor: I'll eyeball samples and run targeted LM-adversarial prompts.

EJ Gomez: i'll reserve a canary pool (isolated nodes) and add scheduling constraint. ops will only flip traffic after ablation sign-off.

Sanjay Rao: thanks — I'll kick off the ablation matrix tonight and drop the artifact links in the thread when done. tagging @Kristin Lee @Ciara Nguyen for follow-up.

spec-bot: note: uploaded artifact summary + raw examples to /artifacts/1728001234/samples.tar.gz (contains 150 raw cases with diffs).
